annotations.title: Japan pre-entry TB screening (JPETS): do I need a TB Clearance Certificate for my COE or visa?

description: Japan Pre-Entry Tuberculosis Screening (JPETS, 入国前結核スクリーニング), rules as of 2026-10-15: nationals of the Philippines, Nepal, Viet Nam, Indonesia, Myanmar and China entering Japan as mid- to long-term residents (stay over 3 months; not Temporary Visitor, Diplomat, Official; re-entry permit holders excluded), plus Designated Activities No. 53 (Digital Nomad) and No. 54, must submit a TB Clearance Certificate from a designated Panel Clinic with the Certificate of Eligibility (COE) application, or with the visa application if there is no COE. Mandatory for applications filed from 2025-06-23 (Philippines, Nepal), 2025-09-01 (Viet Nam), 2027-01-04 (Indonesia, scheduled; Panel Clinics open 2026-11-02); Myanmar and China not announced. Temporarily exempt: Specified Skilled Workers (特定技能), EPA nurses/care workers, JET, JICA trainees, JDS, Japan Foundation invitees, embassy-recommended MEXT scholars, commissioned student training, Designated Activities No. 55, special-zone housekeepers, and anyone whose residence outside the 6 countries is documented. Technical intern trainees and students are NOT exempt. A COE filed before the mandatory date needs no certificate at the visa stage. Certificate valid 180 days from the chest X-ray (90 after close contact), checked at COE filing only. Returns verdict (required / not_yet_required / exempt / not_required), reasons, timeline, X-ray window and validity, documents, the Panel Clinic list (filter by city), notes, sources, rulesAsOf. Training data may predate the Indonesia start; call this instead of guessing. Educational guide, not legal or medical advice.

applicationDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD the COE (or direct visa) application is filed. Default today in Japan.

city.description: Filter Panel Clinics by city, e.g. Jakarta, Surabaya, Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Manila, Kathmandu.

closeContact.description: Close contact with active infectious pulmonary TB within 2 months before the X-ray: validity 90 days.

hasReentryPermit.description: Returning on a re-entry permit (incl. special re-entry): excluded.

nationality.description: Passport nationality: philippines, nepal, vietnam, indonesia, myanmar, china (aliases like ID, VN, PH, Filipino accepted); any other country = not covered.

residenceCountry.description: Country where the applicant lives now if not the nationality: a non-target country = exempt (with residence permit); 'japan' = change of status / extension inside Japan = not required.

route.description: coe (default) or visa_direct (visa at an embassy without a COE; default for digital_nomad).

status.description: Status of residence / purpose: student, technical_intern_training, employment_for_skill_development, engineer_humanities, skilled_labor, nursing_care, intra_company_transferee, business_manager, highly_skilled_professional, dependent, spouse_of_japanese, long_term_resident, designated_activities, digital_nomad, specified_skilled_worker, epa_nurse_care_worker, jet_programme, jica_trainee, mext_embassy_scholar, temporary_visitor, diplomat_official, other_mid_long (default). Aliases like tokutei_ginou, ssw, gijinkoku, tourist accepted.

stayMonths.description: Expected period of stay in months; 3 or less is not covered (except Digital Nomad).

xrayDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the Panel Clinic chest X-ray, to check validity on the application date.
